India rejects Pakistan's terror allegations after Karachi attack

Following a terrorist attack in Karachi that resulted in casualties, Pakistan accused India of involvement. India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) rejected these claims, urging Pakistan to address terrorist networks operating within its own borders. The attack targeted a paramilitary office, with Pakistani forces reporting militants killed in the ensuing clashes.
